our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes this conditional on an AI investment bust, although the headline does not state that condition separately.
A bust means a substantial collapse in AI investment and demand that leaves surplus infrastructure. A stock-market decline alone does not establish this.
Useful infrastructure means economically productive continued operation or reuse of the inherited assets, including useful AI applications.
The dot-com comparison concerns a meaningful infrastructure legacy, not whether any isolated GPU remains usable. No numerical threshold or deadline is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After an established AI investment bust, comprehensive evidence shows that the inherited infrastructure has no meaningful economically productive use or feasible reuse.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After an established AI investment bust, documented operation or reuse shows a meaningful economically productive legacy from the inherited AI infrastructure.
